channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Nigerian forces fire at protesters rallying over deaths of detained miners
item.description: Government has promised to fully investigate after 37 miners died while being held in police custody in Niger State.

item.title: The cost of Iran’s regional leverage
item.description: Tehran’s use of pressure across the region is putting its rapprochement with Gulf states under increasing strain.

item.title: US voter opposition to war on Iran grows to new highs: Poll
item.description: Poll reveals 71 percent in US believe Trump's team lacks a clear strategy for resolving the conflict.

item.title: Pakistan pledges full committment to defence of Saudi Arabia
item.description: Assurance comes amid questions over Pakistan and Turkiye's stance on Riyadh's fight with Houthis following defence pact.

item.title: As Houthis grab Bab al-Mandeb, US appears willing to watch from sidelines
item.description: Stretched by its war with Iran, Washington may have little choice but to trust Houthi assurances on shipping.

item.title: Deadly blast hits mosque at Pakistan police complex
item.description: Several people have reportedly been killed in an explosion at a mosque near a police complex in northwest Pakistan.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
item.description: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

item.title: At least 17 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
item.description: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

item.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
item.description: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.

item.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
item.description: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.
